sources.title: Qwen3.5-122B-A10B official model card
sources.evidence: Exact post-trained checkpoint; nominal language-model counts of 122B total and 10B active; native 262,144 context; multimodal, thinking, and tool-use examples.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-122B-A10B configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen3_5MoeForConditionalGeneration; 48 decoder layers alternate linear and full attention, 256 routed experts with eight selected, shared expert, vision encoder, and one MTP layer.

sources.title: Official Qwen repository release timeline
sources.evidence: The Qwen3.5 repository redirects here; News explicitly dates the release of Qwen3.5-122B-A10B to 2026-02-24.

sources.title: Metadata for the official checkpoint
sources.evidence: Repository creation 2026-02-24; safetensors total 125,086,497,008 parameters (125,086,490,096 BF16 and 6,912 F32). Public, ungated weights.

sources.title: Official checkpoint tensor index
sources.evidence: Checkpoint includes language-model, visual, LM-head, and MTP tensors; full serialized count is broader than the card's language-model count.

sources.title: Checkpoint Apache 2.0 license
sources.evidence: Apache License Version 2.0; copyright 2026 Alibaba Cloud.

sources.title: Official checkpoint publication history
sources.evidence: Initial commit and model-file upload occur on February 24, supporting the open-weight release date independently of later API listings.

name.note: Display punctuation differs from official Qwen3.5-122B-A10B only.

release_date.note: Official release and initial weight upload agree; baseline February 23 is unsupported.

parameters_b.note: Full hosted checkpoint tensor count, including vision and MTP. The card's 122B is a nominal language-model count, not the complete artifact.

active_parameters_b.note: Publisher nominal active language-model count. Not a measured full multimodal execution count.

architecture.note: Hybrid linear/full attention decoder with routed and shared experts, plus vision encoder.

context_window.note: Native configured limit; optional extension to 1,010,000 does not replace it.

modalities.note: Exact card provides image and video prompts with generated text.

reasoning.note: Thinking mode is supported and can be disabled.

tool_call.note: Exact-model serving and Qwen-Agent examples support function calling.

description.value: Qwen vision-language model for visual reasoning, documents, and agent tasks
description.note: Supported by the model overview and document/agent evaluations.

patch.notes: Full checkpoint: 125.086497008B tensor parameters, including vision and MTP weights. Qwen reports a nominal 122B language model with 10B active; active count applies to the language decoder. Native context is 262,144 tokens.

summary: Correct release date and missing license. Distinguish the full 125.086497008B checkpoint from nominal 122B language-model and 10B active counts. Remaining fields confirmed; language-decoder component is publisher-rounded.
